changesets.name: create-app-accessible-themes.md
changesets.text:
---
"@shivaedev/create-app": minor
---

### Added

- Generated apps include light and dark shadcn tokens that meet WCAG AA for text and focus, follow the system color scheme, and offer a saved System, Light or Dark theme choice. A contrast story checks the stylesheet's text and focus pairs.

changesets.name: create-app-auth-migration-drift.md
changesets.text:
---
"@shivaedev/create-app": minor
---

### Added

- Generated apps include a PostgreSQL story that applies every numbered migration and checks Better Auth's configured plugins need no additional columns or tables.

changesets.name: effect-pg-boss-schema-install.md
changesets.text:
---
"@shivaedev/effect-pg-boss": minor
---

### Added

- `installPgBossSchema(options?: PgBossSchemaOptions)` in `schema.ts` installs or upgrades the pg-boss schema through an Effect SQL client without starting workers or schedules. Use it in a test template fixture or release step, then start jobs Layers with `migrate: false`. Failures use `PgBossError` with the new `"install"` operation. Retrying a failed concurrent upgrade rebuilds missing and invalid managed indexes even when the schema version has already committed.

changesets.name: effect-react-auth-action.md
changesets.text:
---
"@shivaedev/effect-react": minor
---

### Added

- `authAction` in `client/authAction.ts` binds Better Auth client promises to native action atoms for `useAction`, with pending state and typed returned failures. Rejected promises fail with the exported `AuthActionUnavailable` error; `AuthActionResult` describes the structural client result.

changesets.name: local-postgres-connections.md
changesets.text:
---
"@shivaedev/local-postgres": patch
---

### Changed

- The shared development PostgreSQL container now allows 500 connections. Existing containers are raised on their next start, preserving their data; containers already allowing 500 or more connections are left running unchanged.
- Setting failures throw `PostgresSettingError` from `localConnections.ts`, identifying the container and `max_connections` setting. The lower-level `ensureConnections(docker, sql, ready)` function applies and verifies the setting through the existing synchronous setup API.

changesets.name: platform-admin-session-requirement.md
changesets.text:
---
"@shivaedev/platform": minor
---

### Breaking

- `requireAdmin` now requires `SessionUser` and fails with `Forbidden` for non-admin users. Put RPC handlers behind `AuthenticatedUser`, and wrap HTTP handlers with `withSessionUser`, so authentication supplies the profile and rejects signed-out requests with `Unauthorized`.

changesets.name: platform-host-preflight.md
changesets.text:
---
"@shivaedev/platform": minor
---

### Added

- `appHost` accepts a native `preflight` Layer that builds before migration checks or execution and application startup. Typed failures stop startup; its services remain available to migrations, application construction, application services, RPC handlers and host callers, and its resources close with the host scope. The host option types accept preflight service, error and requirement parameters and require the Layer whenever any of those types are declared.
- Export `AppHostFactory`, `AppHostInput` and `HostPreflight` types for annotated host factories, inputs and preflight options.

changesets.name: quality-test-projects-dom-coverage.md
changesets.text:
---
"@shivaedev/quality": minor
---

### Added

- `testProjects()` selects test-story's DOM environment for DOM tests and specs, preserving Node host constructors alongside the happy-dom window without a project remap.
- `testProjects({ coverage: true })` enables V8 coverage for selected projects, including unvisited source files and excluding tests and fixtures. The exported `TestProjectsOptions` type also accepts native Vitest coverage options through `coverage` to customize the report.

### Breaking

- DOM projects use test-story's environment instead of plain happy-dom. Install `@shivaedev/test-story` alongside `happy-dom`, and target the DOM window when stubbing browser APIs. Storage fixtures should bind global storage reads to `window.localStorage`; the Node host and DOM window keep separate constructors.

changesets.name: test-story-forwarding-proxy.md
changesets.text:
---
"@shivaedev/test-story": minor
---

### Added

- `forwardingProxy(upstream, options?)` and `ForwardingProxyOptions` from `@shivaedev/test-story/forwardingProxy.ts` provide a scoped loopback proxy for host stories. It forwards requests and responses, appends the caller to `x-forwarded-for`, and applies the story's configured headers.

changesets.name: work-board-answer-controls.md
changesets.text:
---
"@shivaedev/work-board": patch
---

### Changed

- Answer cards use the stock shadcn RadioGroup for single-choice questions and the stock Checkbox for multi-choice questions. Arrow keys move and select within a single-choice question, which is one Tab stop, and Space toggles a multi-choice option. Labels, descriptions, the recommended option and the recorded answers are unchanged.

changesets.name: work-board-first-paint.md
changesets.text:
---
"@shivaedev/work-board": patch
---

### Fixed

- Opening the Board shows its header, sidebar and an "Opening view…" state at once instead of a blank page while the workspace is still being indexed.
- The live status reads "connecting" before the first live update, instead of a red "reconnecting".
- The Board starts indexing the workspace as soon as it starts and reads files concurrently, so the first page after a start waits less for its data.

changesets.name: work-board-plain-status-words.md
changesets.text:
---
"@shivaedev/work-board": patch
---

### Changed

- Today's Needs you, Answered and Later rows no longer repeat their section's state in a status chip; each row keeps its ID, age and Answer control.
- Status chips on Now, goal and item pages, search results, the All work status filter and the Library's rows and status filter show plain words such as "Needs you", "Blocked" or "In progress" instead of raw values like `needs-you`.
- The Library and All work status filters offer one option per plain name, matching every status that shares it, so **Needs you** lists both `needs-you` and `needs-human` items. `client.api.library.query({ status })` matches the same way and returns one entry per name in `statuses`.

- The Today summary row ends with how many workspace sources have problems, linking to a new Source problems section on System, which lists each problem's file, line and reason.

changesets.name: work-fleet-follow-shutdown.md
changesets.text:
---
"@shivaedev/work-fleet": patch
---

### Fixed

- Start the daemon listener after its handlers are ready so reconnecting watches cannot enter an unhandled request during startup.
- End active daemon follow subscriptions before shutting down HTTP so watches reconnect after a restart without waiting on open streams.

changesets.name: work-fleet-lost-turn-relaunch.md
changesets.text:
---
"@shivaedev/work-fleet": minor
---

### Fixed
- Lost accepted Codex turns check thread idleness, remote branches and all PR states before recovery. Active threads wait up to five minutes before asking; merged or closed PRs prevent relaunch. Unpublished work releases its lost execution and relaunches automatically; published work starts a repair turn on the existing branch or PR. Every loss rechecks current thread and publication state, so idle replacements and repairs with conclusive publication evidence recover automatically again. Answers to lost-turn decisions recheck safety and reach the replacement turn. Relaunch prompts keep one copy of the original brief and leave the saved brief unchanged. Status and watch display the recovery reason for the replacement turn and clear it when work advances to review.
- Publication-backed repairs retain recovery eligibility when a replacement turn is rejected by provider capacity, so scheduled retries resume without human intervention.

### Added
- Optional `FleetIntegrations.publication(work)` returns `WorkPublication` (`branch`, `remoteBranch`, optional `pullRequest` and `pullRequestState` (`open`, `closed` or `merged`)) so hosts can supply publication evidence for lost-turn recovery. Missing or inconclusive evidence still needs a decision.
- Optional `Attempt.publishedRecovery` records replacement of a lost turn and whether work was published. Optional `SessionFailure.threadIdle` carries provider thread state for safe recovery; `FleetView.recovery` exposes the recovery reason. Follow snapshots include the recovery reason.

changesets.name: work-fleet-queued-continuations.md
changesets.text:
---
"@shivaedev/work-fleet": minor
---

### Fixed

- Continuing terminal work at full execution capacity records the request and resumes its existing worker thread ahead of new prepared work, including after a restart. Fleet records expose the queued message as the optional `pendingContinuation` string.
- Queued continuations report admission waits and stop for a normal decision when their brief changes. Archived cycles retain their decision owner and exclude queue state.

### Added

- `AttemptProgress` groups the existing worker progress, brief-steering and stall-recovery schemas.
